## Outcome

There was no major public commit this week. I reran the open renderer branches after the recent upstream changes and wrote down what was still failing, what was ready for review, and what could wait until after the final evaluation.

## What I Did

- Checked that PR #336 still preserved explicit `showSelected` behavior.
- Rechecked multiline measurement in PR #339 and the wide/tall viewport cases in PR #253.
- Confirmed the custom-height assertion in PR #288 and clarified the unsupported facet notation in PR #285.
- Chose one final experiment: testing whether `stat_bin` could recompute after an interactive selection.

## Learnings

The reruns gave me enough confidence to keep the last experiment small instead of opening another broad renderer branch.

## Challenges / Notes

No major blocker appeared; most of the work was checking existing branches rather than creating new code.

## Next Week Targets

Write a failing `stat_bin + showSelected` acceptance test and begin the smallest browser-side proof of concept that could pass it.
